capabilities: Resolve bare [[alias]] wikilinks to notes that define that alias
Keep default Obsidian resolution when a link matches a real file name
Pick the nearest note by folder distance when multiple notes share an alias
Support bare aliases in graph view, backlinks, embeds, and preview link state
Index aliases and refresh the index when files or metadata change
extras: Not in the community plugin store; installed via BRAT or by manually copying main.js and manifest.json. The README warns that reused aliases across notes need explicit [[file|alias]] links for deterministic targeting, and notes that letting other plugins like DataView resolve bare aliases is untested.
intentEvidence: Internally, the plugin extends Obsidian's link lookup step with an alias fallback.
problem: Obsidian resolves wikilinks only by file path, so linking via an alias requires writing the verbose [[filename|alias]] form.

relations.evidence: The original idea and a working prototype came from nothingislost/obsidian-auto-linker.

summary: Link-resolution patch that lets bare wikilinks like [[alias]] open notes that define that alias as if the alias were the file name.
